q: How does the design + build process work?
a: One team draws it and builds it. We start with what you want and what's already in the house, work out the plans and materials with you, then build and walk it with you at the end.

q: How long does a typical design + build project take?
a: It depends on the size of the job and how long permits take. You'll get a real schedule before work starts.

q: What types of projects does Timber + Love specialize in?
a: Custom homes, whole-house remodels, kitchens, additions and older Boise houses. Not sure yours fits? Ask. We'll tell you.

q: How do you ensure quality in your projects?
a: At the end we walk the finished house with you and go through the final list together. The houses on this site show the finished work.

q: What makes Timber + Love different from other design + build firms?
a: You get Luke's eye and one team that both designs and builds. Nobody hands your house off to another firm halfway through.
